rule: Before writing Rust, consult the current stable Rust docs and best practices, prefer newer features that improve the core, and record every improvement idea in this record.
chose: Rust work (Phase 2 onward) checks the CURRENT stable Rust release notes, std/crate documentation and community best practices before and while integrating, and adopts newer language or library features where they make sofar-core measurably better (smaller, faster, safer, simpler). Any improvement, idiom or best practice found that is not applied immediately is captured in this record as a note (sofar_add_note) or repo memory (sofar_remember), not left in a session's context. Ruled by the run owner 2026-09-15 during rust-core 1.2.
over: Porting from memory of an older Rust edition and treating the port as a mechanical transcription with no improvement pass.
because: The run owner wants the Rust core to benefit from the newest stable features and idioms rather than reproduce TypeScript structure verbatim, and wants improvement ideas kept in the initiative record so no session loses them.
